name: La Violeta Phase 2 By Dubai Properties
paymentPlan: 10% down payment at sales launch; 50% during construction; 40% on handover
overview: Dubai Properties, a well-known developer of high-end properties, has surpassed itself with its latest venture:La Violeta Phase 2 By Dubai Properties in Villanova, Dubailand. This project represents the epitome of luxurious living and exceptional design, offering townhouses with 3 and 4 bedrooms that are adorned with top-notch amenities and services.
